title: A Short Email from Lisbon
text:
Hi Maria, thanks for your email. I am happy to hear from you. I am in Lisbon this week with my family. The weather is warm and sunny.

Come and visit me next month! We can walk by the river and eat fish together. Please write back soon. Love, Ana.

questions.text: What does Ana ask Maria to do next month?
How does Ana probably feel about Maria's email?
What kind of relationship do Ana and Maria probably have?

vocabulary.definition: having a fairly high temperature that feels pleasant
a large natural stream of water that flows to the sea or a lake
to go and spend time with someone at their home or place

paragraph_translations: Oi, Maria, obrigada pelo seu e-mail. Fico feliz em receber notícias suas. Estou em Lisboa esta semana com a minha família. O tempo está quente e ensolarado.
Venha me visitar no próximo mês! Podemos caminhar pelo rio e comer peixe juntas. Por favor, responda logo. Um abraço, Ana.
